meta.as_of_semantics: as_of_date is exclusive: the snapshot dated D contains bouts with event_date < D, so a bout fought on D is excluded by the snapshot dated D. ?as_of=D resolves to the latest stored snapshot with as_of_date <= D, which therefore never contains a bout fought on or after D.
